headline: **MLB Daily Roundup: June 27, 2026**
article:
The Houston Astros suffered a tough defeat, losing 8-0 to the Detroit Tigers. James Outman led the Astros' offense with a home run and three RBIs. In other news, the Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Noelvi Marte leading the offense with a home run and 2 RBI. The Boston Red Sox also secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, handing the Yankees their loss.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, including Hoby Milner of the Chicago Cubs, who was placed on the 15-day injured list due to appendicitis. Jesús Sánchez of the Toronto Blue Jays was placed on the 10-day injured list with a right ankle sprain. The San Francisco Giants also placed Daniel Susac on the 10-day injured list with a low back strain.

There were several notable trades and roster moves, including the Chicago Cubs acquiring LHP David Peterson from the New York Mets in exchange for 3B Cole Mathis. The Houston Astros also acquired SS Marcus Brown from the Washington Nationals for cash.

top_news.title: **Astros Fall to Tigers in Dominant 8-0 Loss**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros suffered a tough defeat, losing 8-0 to the Detroit Tigers. James Outman led the Astros' offense with a home run and three RBIs.

top_news.title: **Reds Take Down Pirates 6-4**
top_news.summary: The Cincinnati Reds secured a 6-4 victory over the Pittsburgh Pirates, with Noelvi Marte leading the offense with a home run and 2 RBI. Brock Burke earned the win with a strong relief appearance, striking out 2 batters in 1 inning of work.

top_news.title: **Nationals Fall to Orioles in 1-3 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Washington Nationals suffered a 1-3 loss to the Baltimore Orioles, with Trevor Rogers earning the win after 6.1 innings of work. Rogers struck out 7 batters and allowed just 1 earned run in the contest.

top_news.title: **Rangers Rally Past Blue Jays 5-4**
top_news.summary: The Texas Rangers secured a narrow victory over the Toronto Blue Jays, winning 5-4. Justin Foscue led the Rangers' offense with a 2-hit, 1-home run, 3-RBI performance.

top_news.title: **Astros Take Down Tigers 8-6**
top_news.summary: The Houston Astros secured an 8-6 victory over the Detroit Tigers in a closely contested matchup. Jeremy Peña and Yainer Diaz were among the key contributors for the Astros, while Isaac Paredes and Riley Greene had notable performances for the Tigers.

top_news.title: **Yankees Fall to Red Sox in Boston**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 4-1 victory over the New York Yankees, handing the Yankees their loss. Impact players for the Red Sox included Max Schuemann, Masataka Yoshida, and Marcelo Mayer.

top_news.title: **Cubs LHP Hoby Milner Lands on Injured List**
top_news.summary: Chicago Cubs left-handed pitcher Hoby Milner has been placed on the 15-day injured list due to appendicitis, effective retroactive to June 26, 2026.

top_news.title: **Cubs Acquire Left-Handed Pitcher in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Chicago Cubs have acquired left-handed pitcher David Peterson in a trade. Peterson joins the Cubs after being previously traded from the New York Mets.
